capabilities.description: Track scheduled and unscheduled maintenance for each aircraft, including work orders, part lifecycles, and compliance with airworthiness directives.
Maintain an immutable audit trail of all operational, maintenance, and training records, with evidence verification and readiness scoring for regulatory inspections.
Central registry of aircraft, engines, propellers, and components with configuration details, ownership, and lease information.
Manage pilot and crew certifications, training schedules, duty-time limits, and qualification expiry alerts.
Generate, store, and version-control flight manuals, checklists, and regulatory documents with automated distribution and acknowledgment tracking.
Interactive dashboards and analytics for fleet utilization, maintenance costs, compliance status, and safety trends.
AI-powered knowledge base for flight operations, maintenance procedures, and regulatory references, with semantic search across manuals and incident reports.

summary: Aviation Operations Hub is an integrated platform for airlines, charter operators, and private flight departments to manage fleet compliance, maintenance, crew readiness, and flight operations. It centralizes airworthiness tracking, regulatory audits, document control, and operational analytics so teams can maintain safety, reduce downtime, and stay audit-ready.
